description: Na₅VO₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.54 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.65 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. There is one shorter (1.74 Å) and three longer (1.75 Å) V-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Na atoms to form ONa₆ octahedra that share corners with nine ONa₆ octahedra and edges with five ONa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-54°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₅V octahedra that share corners with four ONa₆ octahedra, edges with six ONa₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ONa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-54°.
